name: recordFood
description: Parse a single food item the user consumed into a structured record. Use this when the user tells you what they ate. Save every nutrition value the user states exactly as stated. Estimate only the nutrition values (calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber) the user did not give, for the food and amount: for a packaged or restaurant food, base them on the brand's published nutrition for that product; for any other food, or when you do not know the brand's values, base them on USDA FoodData Central values for that food, or for the closest generic food in FoodData Central.

unit.description: Unit of the amount, such as g, ml, piece, serving.

date.description: Date the food was consumed, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

genericInfo.description: General info about the consumed food.
